about_the_game:
You're a potion master... but the question is whose side you're on.

Potion Politics Simulator invites you to become not only a craftsman of potions, but also a master of interests, alliances and strategies. In a world where powerful lodges fight fiercely, you work your way up from a small potion shop to become an influential figure.

🏛️ Lodges and Relationships

In Potion Politics Simulator you not only produce potions, but also try to find your place in a region shaped by the power struggle of different lodges. Each customer is a representative of the lodge they belong to - their demands are not just products, but a message.

Customers come to your shop according to the specific needs of the lodges they belong to. When you provide them with the potions they are looking for, you don't just make a sale; your relationship with the respective lodge is strengthened and the popularity of your shop increases. This popularity attracts more prestigious and influential customers to your shop - more profit, but also greater responsibility.

But be careful:

⚖️ Dissatisfaction means not only losing customers, but weakening your ties with a lodge. This can ostracize you, make you vulnerable to threats or put you in economic difficulty.

Managing relationships becomes even more critical than potion making.

Who will you prioritize? Whose request will you turn down?

Your answers to these questions will determine not only your shop, but also your fate in the game.

🌿🧪 Botany & Alchemy

The power of potions comes from deep in the earth.

You get the seeds from the lodges' markets and grow them in your own fields.

Relationships determine prices; experience determines quality.

Quality plants mean powerful potions.

Strong potions bring both profit and reputation.

📜 Dynamic Story & Politics

The bonds you forge with the lodges pull you into the center of the story.

A lodge prepares for war and asks you for special potions.

If you accept, you gain friendship, but you close another door.

Every decision shapes not only the present but also the future.

Every playthrough requires a brand new strategy.

🎯 Add to Wishlist Now!

There is no limit to potion production in Potion Politics Simulator!

Create countless combinations with the herbs you grow and increase your power with each new strategy. Thanks to the variety of local herbs, each gameplay offers a completely different experience.

Your relationships with the Lodges not only change your trade, but also the flow of the story.

Every decision leaves a lasting mark on the game's world - shifting the political balance, shaking the balance of economic power.

The shop is yours. The choice is yours. The power is in your hands.

💡 Add Potion Politics Simulator to your Steam wishlist now and be one of the first to discover this unique simulation!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 570
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX uyumlu ses kartı
  • VR Support: Desteklenmiyor

short_description: Run your own potion shop. Grow plants, produce potions, set prices, satisfy customers and build complex relationships with lodges. Every decision becomes a political game that affects costs, alliances and the fate of the story.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Turkish, Bulgarian, Danish, Finnish, Polish, Hungarian, Norwegian, Romanian, Greek, Czech
